def add(a, b):
    """Tiny sample for BPE training. Repeat so merges exist.
    Python katas teach short functions, unit tests, and write-test-fix loops.
    """
    return a + b


def is_palindrome(s):
    t = "".join(ch.lower() for ch in s if not ch.isspace())
    return t == t[::-1]


text = """
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
Python is a programming language used for coding katas.
Write a function, run tests, fix the solution, finish the episode.
""" * 40
